zh.title: 國軍聯合防禦操演結束 驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量
zh.summary: 國軍於7月13至17日舉行聯合防禦操演並已結束，知情人士指出操演驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量；學者蘇紫雲表示戰略預備隊為核心編制，並提到裝備AH-64E阿帕契的陸航601旅部分單位直屬參謀本部，未來在漢光實兵想定下將涵蓋陸海空戰力以護衛核心設施。
body: 國軍聯合防禦操演日前結束，知情人士指出此次操演已驗證直屬參謀本部的戰略預備隊應變能量。
操演於7月13日至17日舉行，參謀總長指揮不同單位組成的戰略預備隊，被視為國軍關鍵力量之一。
國防安全研究院學者蘇紫雲接受中央社訪問時說明，戰略預備隊是軍事作戰核心編制，保留戰術彈性以應對突破與填補缺口。
蘇紫雲指出，根據國防部公開資訊，配備AH-64E阿帕契攻擊直升機的陸航601旅部分單位直屬參謀本部，且具高速機動跨域能力的空軍聯隊與海軍兵力亦納入戰略預備隊想定。
他推測，在漢光實兵等聯合作戰想定下，戰略預備隊將不再局限於單一陸上打擊，而是涵蓋陸海空三軍戰力，於關鍵時刻鞏固政經核心與關鍵基礎設施安全。

en.title: Joint defense exercise concludes, verifies General Staff strategic reserve responsiveness
en.summary: The ROC armed forces completed a joint defense exercise held July 13‑17, and informed sources said the drill verified the responsiveness of the strategic reserve directly under the General Staff. Scholar Su Tzu‑yun of the Institute for National Defense and Security Research described the reserve as a core operational construct, noted that elements of the 601st Army Aviation Brigade equipped with AH‑64E Apache helicopters are under the General Staff, and speculated that under Han Kuang live‑fire scenarios the reserve will integrate land, sea and air forces to protect key political‑economic assets.
body: The joint defense exercise concluded recently, and informed sources said it verified the responsiveness of the strategic reserve directly subordinate to the General Staff.
The exercise took place from July 13 to 17, with the Chief of the General Staff commanding reserve elements drawn from multiple units, regarded as a key national defense asset.

Su Tzu‑yun, a scholar at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research, explained that the strategic reserve forms the core of operational organization, retaining tactical flexibility to react to breakthroughs and fill gaps.

Su noted that, per publicly released Ministry of National Defense information, parts of the 601st Army Aviation Brigade equipped with AH‑64E Apache attack helicopters are under the General Staff, and high‑mobility air force wings and naval forces are also included in the reserve concept.

He speculated that under Han Kuang live‑fire operational concepts the reserve will no longer be limited to ground strikes but will encompass joint land, sea and air forces to safeguard core political‑economic centers and critical infrastructure at decisive moments.

zh.title: 國防部：偵獲7艘共艦3艘公務船及4架次共機
zh.summary: 國防部公布自25日上午6時至26日上午6時，偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船及4架次共機在台海周邊活動，未逾越海峽中線，國軍以任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部今天發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船及4架次共機，持續在台海周邊活動。
期間並無共機逾越台灣海峽中線。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
此為例行公布之共機艦動態資料，供外界參考。

en.title: ROC Defense Ministry detects 7 PLA warships, 3 coast‑guard vessels, 4 aircraft sorties
en.summary: The Ministry of National Defense reported that from 06:00 on 25 July to 06:00 on 26 July it detected seven People's Liberation Army warships, three coast‑guard vessels and four aircraft sorties operating around the Taiwan Strait. No PLA aircraft crossed the median line, and the ROC armed forces employed mission aircraft, ships and shore‑based missile systems to monitor and respond.
body: The Ministry of National Defense today released the joint aircraft‑ship dynamics, stating that from 06:00 yesterday to 06:00 today it detected seven PLA warships, three coast‑guard vessels and four aircraft sorties continuing activity around the Taiwan Strait.
During the period no PLA aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line.
The Ministry emphasized that the ROC military used mission aircraft, ships and shore‑based missile systems to closely monitor and handle the situation.
This is routine publication of PLA aircraft and ship activity for public reference.
